anchors.title: Adelaide Central Market
anchors.description: One of the largest undercover fresh-produce markets in the Southern Hemisphere. 70+ traders selling artisan cheese, charcuterie, baked goods, smallgoods and coffee. Open Tuesday to Saturday.

anchors.title: Adelaide Botanic Garden
anchors.description: Free historic gardens dating from 1855, with the Bicentennial Conservatory, Amazon Waterlily Pavilion and the Museum of Economic Botany. Daily free guided walks at 10:30am.

anchors.title: Adelaide Zoo — Giant Pandas
anchors.description: Australia's second-oldest zoo and the only zoo in the southern hemisphere with giant pandas. 2,500 animals across 8 hectares in the centre of the city, beside the Botanic Gardens.

anchors.title: Adelaide Oval RoofClimb
anchors.description: 50-metre climb to the top of the Adelaide Oval's heritage roof, with 360° views across the city, parklands and St Peter's Cathedral. Day and twilight climbs run daily.

anchors.title: Art Gallery of South Australia
anchors.description: Free, neoclassical gallery on North Terrace with 45,000 works — Australia's second-oldest public collection. Strong holdings in Aboriginal art, plus rotating international exhibitions.

anchors.title: Glenelg Beach by Tram
anchors.description: Catch the historic tram from the city centre to Glenelg — Adelaide's classic seaside suburb. Long white-sand beach, Moseley Square fountains and a heritage jetty for sunset photos.

TUESDAY.title: Central Market — Tuesday Lunch
TUESDAY.description: The market kicks off the week with full produce floors and breakfast at Lucia's Pizza Bar (open since 1957) or coffee from Lucia's espresso counter.

FRIDAY.title: Adelaide Central Market Night Market
FRIDAY.description: On the first Friday of each month the Central Market stays open into the evening with live music, hot food and free tastings across the produce floor.

SATURDAY.title: Adelaide Showground Farmers Market
SATURDAY.description: Every Sunday 9am-1pm at the Wayville Showground — 60+ South Australian growers, makers and butchers. Free entry; on-site coffee and breakfast vans.

SUNDAY.title: Gilles Street Market
SUNDAY.description: Third Sunday of every month — Adelaide's biggest street-style market with vintage fashion, plants, handmade design and 30+ food trucks. 10am-4pm at Gilles Street Primary.
